digest.component_or_area: MCP error envelope and LLM-tier error classification
propositions: MCP read tools render_workflow and get_workflow_status report not-found and caller-input failures with error code llm_unavailable instead of a distinct caller-error code, defeating agent-side error branching
The WorkflowError and WorkflowParseError exception hierarchy are subclasses of LLMError, causing error_code_for to blanket-map all workflow errors to llm_unavailable regardless of actual cause
A not-found workflow name or unknown run_id should return error code not_found, distinct from llm_unavailable, so agents can distinguish transient outages from unrecoverable caller mistakes

The fix introduces WorkflowNotFoundError subclass and reroutes exception classification per-subclass in error_code_for, mapping not-found to not_found and parse errors to invalid_input while preserving llm_unavailable for genuine execution-time LLM outages

The defect was introduced by commit 77f1c4011c83 (ticket 8a31) which added structured error codes but applied a blanket LLMError→llm_unavailable mapping without carving out workflow caller-input and not-found subclasses

Both _structured_llm_failure and error_code_for sites required fixes to maintain consistency; vocabulary additions (not_found, invalid_input) to KNOWN_ERROR_CODES, schemas, and documentation complete the contract
